# Tracking Events

Source: https://docs.linkzly.com/docs/sdk-tracking-events

This page is for the step after install: which events to send, how to name them, and where those names are used later in the console. It applies to all four mobile SDKs, and every code sample is shown in Swift, Kotlin, TypeScript and Dart. Install and configure the SDK first, using the Installation section of your platform page: [iOS](https://docs.linkzly.com/docs/sdk-ios#installation), [Android](https://docs.linkzly.com/docs/sdk-android#installation), [React Native](../sdk/installation.md) or [Flutter](https://docs.linkzly.com/docs/sdk-flutter#installation).

The names in the examples are suggestions. Linkzly does not reserve any custom event name. One step is required before a custom event is kept: you add its name to your app in the console (see [Register each name in the console](../events/sending-a-custom-event.md)).
